records.source: Stardew Valley Fair
records.translation: Perya ng Stardew Valley

records.source: I beat all these games last year!$h
records.translation: Nalampasan ko ang lahat ng larong ito noong nakaraang taon!$h

records.source: I learned all of Robin's techniques last year, but she's always one step ahead of me!
records.translation: Natutuhan ko ang lahat ng pamamaraan ni Robin noong nakaraang taon, pero lagi siyang may lamang na isang hakbang sa akin!

records.source: mumph... This is my one chance to pig out on barbecue sandwiches.
records.translation: mumf... Ito lang ang pagkakataon kong magpakabusog sa mga sandwich na barbecue.

records.source: I hope we win the grange display contest!
records.translation: Sana manalo tayo sa paligsahan ng Tanghalang Bukid!

records.source: Did you remember to bring good stuff for our grange display? I hope we win this year.
records.translation: Naalala mo bang magdala ng magagandang bagay para sa Tanghalang Bukid natin? Sana manalo tayo ngayong taon.

records.source: Hey, @. I'm just catching up with Sam. Go ahead and have some fun.
records.translation: Hoy, @. Nakikipagkumustahan lang ako kay Sam. Sige, magsaya ka muna.

records.source: Sebastian's the same as always. Are you having fun at the festival?
records.translation: Ganoon pa rin si Sebastian gaya ng dati. Nagsasaya ka ba sa pista?

records.source: I'm just catching up with some old friends... you go on and have a good time.
records.translation: Nakikipagkuwentuhan lang ako sa ilang dating kaibigan... mauna ka na at magsaya.

records.source: I'll wait here until you're ready to go home...
records.translation: Maghihintay ako rito hanggang handa ka nang umuwi...

records.source: The smokey aroma drew me here, yet 'twas the zesty sauce that truly sealed my fate... *gurgle*$s
records.translation: Dinala ako rito ng mausok na halimuyak, ngunit ang sarsang matapang ang lasa ang tunay na nagtakda sa aking kapalaran... *kulog ng tiyan*$s

records.source: I already beat all the games... now what?
records.translation: Nalampasan ko na ang lahat ng laro... ano naman ngayon?

records.source: Woodworking is an ancient tradition that I'm very proud to be a part of.$h
records.translation: Sinaunang tradisyon ang paggawa sa kahoy at ipinagmamalaki kong bahagi ako nito.$h

records.source: Robin really works hard on her carpentry stuff... she deserves a little recognition now and then.
records.translation: Talagang nagsisikap si Robin sa kaniyang pag-aanluwagi... karapat-dapat siyang kilalanin paminsan-minsan.

records.source: *slurp* mmm... this barbecue sauce is amazing.$h
records.translation: *higop* mmm... napakasarap ng sarsang pang-ihaw na ito.$h

records.source: It's kinda hectic today... I'm just gonna hang out here for a while.
records.translation: Medyo magulo ngayon... Tatambay lang muna ako rito.

records.source: My store carries the very finest quality products in the whole valley. Please, inspect my grange display closely and see for yourself!
records.translation: Nagbebenta ang tindahan ko ng mga produktong may pinakamahusay na kalidad sa buong lambak. Pakisuri nang mabuti ang Tanghalang Bukid ko at tingnan mo mismo!

records.source: Pierre is very serious about his grange display. He's been setting aside the best-looking produce for weeks in preparation.#$e#Hey, best of luck to you if you enter!
records.translation: Napakaseryoso ni Pierre sa Tanghalang Bukid niya. Ilang linggo niyang itinabi ang pinakamagagandang ani bilang paghahanda.#$e#Hoy, sana palarin ka kung sasali ka!

records.source: These animals never judge people by their looks. The same can't be said for humans.
records.translation: Hindi hinuhusgahan ng mga hayop na ito ang mga tao batay sa anyo. Hindi gayon ang mga tao.

records.source: I played the 'Strength' game too many times and now my arms feel like rubber.
records.translation: Napakaraming beses kong nilaro ang larong 'Lakas' at parang goma na ngayon ang mga braso ko.

records.source: Hmm... smoked turkey haunch? I guess this festival isn't all bad.$h
records.translation: Hmm... pinausukang hita ng pabo? Mukhang hindi naman ganap na masama ang pistang ito.$h

records.source: I wish Gus would include a vegetarian option. Some zucchini skewers, maybe?
records.translation: Sana magdagdag si Gus ng pagkaing walang karne. Baka mga tuhog na zucchini?

records.source: Well @, it's the big day... Our most important festival of the year, the 'Stardew Valley Fair'.#$b#If you'd like to participate by setting up a grange display, I've left an empty stand for you. Just let me know after you've set everything up so we can get to the judging.
records.translation: Aba, @, ito na ang malaking araw... Ang pinakamahalagang pista natin sa buong taon, ang 'Perya ng Stardew Valley'.#$b#Kung gusto mong sumali sa pamamagitan ng paghahanda ng Tanghalang Bukid, nag-iwan ako ng bakanteng puwesto para sa iyo. Sabihin mo lang kapag naihanda mo na ang lahat para makapagsimula ang pagsusuri ng mga hurado.

records.source: I complain about my job sometimes, but I do take pride in my work.#$b#These are some of my finest pieces. I hope you like them.
records.translation: Kung minsan ay nagrereklamo ako tungkol sa trabaho ko, pero talagang ipinagmamalaki ko ito.#$b#Ilan ito sa pinakamahuhusay kong gawa. Sana magustuhan mo.

records.source: You know, I would've made a pretty good clown. I think I missed my calling.
records.translation: Alam mo, mahusay sana akong payaso. Mukhang hindi ko nasunod ang tunay kong bokasyon.

records.source: I won the wheel of chance ten times in a row and now the man won't let me play anymore...$s
records.translation: Sampung sunod na beses akong nanalo sa Gulong ng Suwerte at ayaw na akong palaruin ng lalaki...$s

records.source: Better hurry up, kid... Before ol' Pam here fishes every last lunker out of the tent! Hehe.$h
records.translation: Bilisan mo, bata... Bago mahuli ni Pam ang lahat ng dambuhalang isda sa tolda! Hehe.$h

records.source: Have you been to the fortune teller? She set up her stand in the graveyard.#$e#I already saw her... she told me something... interesting. *giggle*$h
records.translation: Nakapunta ka na ba sa manghuhula? Nagtayo siya ng puwesto sa sementeryo.#$e#Nakita ko na siya... May sinabi siyang... kawili-wili. *hagikgik*$h

records.source: He doesn't look very happy... I guess Mayor Lewis had to cut costs with a budget clown this year.
records.translation: Mukhang hindi siya masaya... Baka kinailangang magtipid ni Alkalde Lewis sa mumurahing payaso ngayong taon.

records.source: I'm waiting for this clown to start doing something funny.#$e#Pretty disappointing.
records.translation: Hinihintay kong magsimulang gumawa ng nakakatawang bagay ang payasong ito.#$e#Nakakadismaya.

records.source: Hey @. Having a good time?#$e#The slingshot tent is pretty fun, and if you get good at it you can really rack up the star tokens.
records.translation: Hoy, @. Nagsasaya ka ba?#$e#Masaya ang tolda ng Tirador, at kung mahusay ka, makakaipon ka talaga ng maraming Token na Bituin.

records.source: I really admire Robin's carpentry skills. I use a lot of the same techniques in my own line of work.
records.translation: Talagang hinahangaan ko ang husay ni Robin sa pag-aanluwagi. Marami akong ginagamit na kaparehong pamamaraan sa sarili kong gawain.

records.source: All these animals are friendly and love to get massaged.
records.translation: Palakaibigan ang lahat ng hayop na ito at gustong-gusto nilang minamasahe.

records.source: I tried my best, but my display is pretty weak compared to Pierre's.$s#$e#Well, maybe the judges will give me bonus points for the massive cheese wheel.
records.translation: Ginawa ko ang lahat, pero hindi gaanong maganda ang Tanghalang Bukid ko kumpara sa kay Pierre.$s#$e#Baka bigyan ako ng mga hurado ng karagdagang puntos para sa napakalaking bilog na keso.

records.source: I'm trying to get Gus to tell me his sauce recipe, but he won't budge.
records.translation: Sinisikap kong hikayatin si Gus na sabihin sa akin ang resipe ng sarsa niya, pero ayaw niyang bumigay.

records.source: Eat as much as you like! It's all free today... compliments of Mayor Lewis.$h#$e#Oh! Make sure to dribble some of my secret sauce on there.
records.translation: Kumain ka hangga't gusto mo! Libre ang lahat ngayon... handog ni Alkalde Lewis.$h#$e#Ah! Tiyaking patakan mo ng lihim kong sarsa ang pagkain mo.

records.source: You say it's raining up above? *gasp*#$e#Rain... It's almost mythical to us. Some of us live our entire lives without ever experiencing it.
records.translation: Sabi mo, umuulan sa itaas? *napasinghap*#$e#Ulan... halos alamat lang iyon sa amin. Ang ilan sa amin ay nabubuhay nang hindi iyon nararanasan kailanman.

records.source: Welwick and I have known each other for a long time... she is a remarkable diviner, and a good friend.#$e#...#$e#That clown... I know him from somewhere.#$e#Was it the school of illusion? Or maybe the Carnival of Secrets? Hmm...
records.translation: Matagal na kaming magkakilala ni Welwick... pambihirang manghuhula at mabuting kaibigan siya.#$e#...#$e#Ang payasong iyon... Parang kilala ko siya.#$e#Sa paaralan ba ng ilusyon? O baka sa Karnabal ng mga Lihim? Hmm...

records.source: And just a few steps over there, Gus is grilling up a batch of pork ribs... Yikes.$s#$e#I've got some soul-searching to do...$11
records.translation: At ilang hakbang lang mula rito, nag-iihaw si Gus ng isang bunton ng tadyang ng baboy... Naku.$s#$e#Kailangan kong magnilay-nilay...$11

records.source: I heard it's raining back home. Is that why you came here?$h#$e#I kind of miss the rain, actually...$s
records.translation: Narinig kong umuulan sa inyo. Iyon ba ang dahilan kung bakit ka pumunta rito?$h#$e#Sa totoo lang, medyo hinahanap-hanap ko rin ang ulan...$s

records.source: Ow! A hen pecked my little finger!$u
records.translation: Aray! Tinuka ng inahin ang kalingkingan ko!$u

records.source: Moooo!
records.translation: Moooo!
records.preserveReason: Nonlexical cow imitation; preserving “Moooo!” keeps the intended animal sound without untranslated semantic text.

records.source: Clint's blades get sharper every year.#$e#So do his prices...
records.translation: Lalong tumatalas ang mga talim ni Clint bawat taon.#$e#Ganoon din ang mga presyo niya...

records.source: Are you setting up a grange display, @? It's your chance to show off all the good produce from %farm!
records.translation: Naghahanda ka ba ng Tanghalang Bukid, @? Pagkakataon mong ipagmalaki ang lahat ng magandang ani mula sa %farm!

records.source: Haha! I've never seen anything like this before...$h
records.translation: Haha! Wala pa akong nakitang tulad nito...$h
